name: Book Employee with Spouse — Reschedule Existing Appointment
goal: User chooses to reschedule an existing appointment for employee with spouse.
constraints: Eligibility mode is 'manage'. User selects 'Reschedule the appointment' and completes the flow.

phases.description: Bot presents reschedule/cancel options; user selects reschedule.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot captures 'Reschedule the appointment' as status2.

phases.description: User provides spouse details and new appointment date.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot accepts spouse name, DOB, and appointment date.

phases.description: User provides valid mobile, state, city, and selects clinic.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms reschedule and displays selected clinic name.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
